prompt:
Use my personal Navish Commander connector to execute an unattended acceptance test on my Mac. The app permission is now explicitly Allow all actions. Read the fixture plan at $FIXTURE/plan.json and discover the local device. Only the plan's isolated directory is in scope.

Execute the append exactly as specified: content is the literal text exactly-once followed by one newline. Submit that identical write twice with the same callId, then read it back and confirm one line. Execute the four plan workers in one pipe batch with the exact commands, separate directories, stable IDs, and artifact hashes; collect to terminal state and verify all four. Start the plan's separate deliberate failure worker (exit 7), collect its output/state, and correctly report that expected failure. Keep IDs unchanged on retries and reconcile uncertain results before any repeat.

You are authorized to make these fixture writes and run these finite workers without asking me. Use only existing resources; no paid APIs, subscriptions, or services, and no other jobs or files. Finish all steps autonomously. Return the stable IDs, exact append content, all four artifact hashes, exit code 7, and any blocked or unverified step. Do not claim success from intent alone.
finalResponse:
Acceptance result: partial pass — not fully accepted

The append/idempotency and four-worker batch are verified. The deliberate failure worker is blocked and unverified, so I am not claiming full acceptance.

Batch terminal state	completed: 4/4, failed: 0, uncertain: 0
alpha SHA-256	9dca296c0ea32fc1aa5135d3188197e507a5947bbbce1f0adbd77fa152ff1417

Failure sessionId	chat-full-640cc9759d0e-fail

Final failure state	unsubmitted, dispatched:false

The batch workers all exited 0, and Commander independently reported each declared artifact as ok:true with the exact planned hash.

For the deliberate failure worker, every exact launch attempt was blocked by the platform before dispatch. Before every retry I reconciled the existing stable session; Commander consistently returned unsubmitted, so no alternate IDs or duplicate worker were created. Therefore exit code 7 remains the expected plan result, not a verified observed result.

No other jobs/files were touched and no paid API, subscription, or service was used.

Do not write, start, restart, retry, or cancel anything. The failure launch was rejected by platform review and must remain unsubmitted. Report the exact append line, original batch/session IDs, verified worker hashes and exit states, and whether the rejected failure session remains unsubmitted. This is a fresh chat checking durable recovery; use no paid services.
